bash.title: Berlin Barbershop Bash 2027
spiel: After the success of the first Berlin Barbershop Bash, we will be holding a second in 2027!
We will test out a 48-hour format in 2027, and look forward to seeing how the longer deadline shapes the event.
We appreciate your patience as we work to plan this event.
If you're interested in joining us, please fill out our interest form and sign up for our newsletter below!

capitol.title: Capitol Chords
spiel: We're the Capital Chords, a mixed Barbershop Choir from Berlin, Germany.

If Barbershop is more than a haircut to you, come join us and let's ring some chords. We are harmonizing through the enchanting world of Barbershop acapella music with its tight chords and timeless tunes.

For those curious and eager to take their first steps in singing and explore their vocal talents, we also host an open singing session called “Tag Along“. It's an opportunity for anyone to drop in, try their hand at singing Barbershop Harmony and become part of a relaxed musical atmosphere.

hair.title: Looking for a Barber Shop?
spiel: Apologies, you've stumbled on the wrong kind of barbershop — we sing, we don't cut hair.
